objective: Develop a cumulative trading solution from independently evidenced mechanisms across markets and regimes, while preserving all existing prospective freezes.

lanes.name: information_context
lanes.role: event/regime conditioning, not standalone promotion without economics

lanes.name: cross_market
lanes.role: diversify source market and test transferability

cumulative_scoreboard.combination_rule: Do not combine lanes merely because each endpoint is positive. Combination requires positive prospective evidence plus sufficiently distinct return/signal behavior and a declared portfolio construction rule.

parallel_rules: Existing frozen prospective watches continue unchanged.
New discovery lanes cannot alter an existing candidate.
Rejected families are not rescued by leverage or post-hoc filters.
Context tools such as news and sentiment require demonstrated incremental economics before becoming trading rules.
Cross-market data-source and entitlement differences remain explicit.
Portfolio/ensemble testing starts only from survivors and uses future or separately locked evidence.
